meta.name: vega
meta.description: Create data-driven charts with Vega-Lite (declarative) and Vega (programmatic). Best for statistical visualization of numeric data — bar, line, scatter, heatmap, area, radar charts, and word clouds.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用声明式语法快速生成统计图表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要将数据转化为直观的统计图表
copy.tagline_en: Create statistical charts quickly with declarative syntax
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn data into intuitive statistical charts

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你提供的数据，自动生成柱状图、折线图、散点图、热力图、面积图、雷达图、词云等统计图表。你只需描述数据和要求，Claude 会输出 Vega-Lite 或 Vega 代码，渲染成图表。
howto.when: 当你需要可视化数值数据（如销售额、温度变化），或要求绘制柱状图、折线图、散点图等统计图表时触发。

say.text: 用以下数据画一张柱状图：产品A销量100，产品B销量150。
say.note: Claude 会生成 Vega-Lite 代码并渲染柱状图。

say.text: 绘制过去一周每天温度的折线图。
say.note: Claude 会生成折线图代码并展示。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate statistical charts (bar, line, scatter, heatmap, area, radar, word cloud) from your data. You describe the data and requirements, and Claude outputs Vega-Lite or Vega code to render the chart.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to visualize numeric data (e.g., sales, temperature) or request a specific chart type like bar, line, scatter, etc.

say_en.text: Draw a bar chart with this data: Product A sales 100, Product B sales 150.
say_en.note: Claude will generate Vega-Lite code and render a bar chart.

say_en.text: Plot a line chart of daily temperatures for the past week.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a line chart and display it.
